subject: Backup purge lag + SLA bridging plan
messages:
From: Karen Su <karen.su@healthbridge.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@healthbridge.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on recent purge lag and retention carve-out

Marissa —

Thanks for taking this on. Over the weekend our ops team noticed that a scheduled backup purge did not complete for a batch of EU customer logs (range 2027-04-20 to 2027-04-26). This triggered an internal compliance alert because our contract (DPA Appendix B) expects a maximum 14-day window for staged deletion after a retention signal.

We need two things quickly:
- A brief explanation of why the purge lag occurred and whether it involved any subprocessors in the chain (we must capture subprocessor names and regions).
- A proposed mitigation and temporary bridging plan so we can avoid an audit finding—ideally with dates and a rollback/restore safeguard.

I'm copying HealthBridge Legal for visibility; they may request evidence (logs, retention policy snapshots).

Appreciate a prompt reply — our compliance review is scheduled Wednesday.

Karen
Karen Su
Head of Platform Ops
HealthBridge

Attachments: healthbridge_evidence.zip (logs bundle, redacted)
From: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Su <karen.su@healthbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on recent purge lag and retention carve-out

Karen —

Thanks for the heads up and for the evidence bundle. I pulled the initial incident notes and wanted to share a short summary while we investigate in depth:

- What happened: a backfill job for cross-region snapshot consolidation ran longer than expected and overlapped a scheduled purge window. The consolidation temporarily pinned a small set of snapshot manifests, preventing the purge worker from removing the corresponding objects.
- Scale: ~3.4k customer log files affected (EU region), all tied to snapshots created during 2027-04-20 — 2027-04-26. No plaintext customer data leaked — objects remained in server-side encrypted buckets.
- Subprocessors: the consolidation job touched our backup vendor (SnapshotCo) for offsite transfer; we also used an ephemeral transfer service (FastMover) for the run.

Immediate ask: can you provisionally accept a 72-hour bridging window while we execute a safe purge and provide forensic evidence? If Legal needs a written carve-out, we can propose an exception letter and include timeline/controls.

I'll loop in Kimberly and Karthik to propose the concrete timeline and evidence package.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: purge-timeline-v1.xlsx (draft mitigation plan)
From: kimberly.park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, Karen Su <karen.su@healthbridge.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed bridging plan and proof items

Karen / team —

We've reviewed the traces and attached a proposed bridging plan (see purge-timeline-v1.xlsx). Key points:

- Controlled purge window: start 2027-05-04T02:00Z — end 2027-05-04T08:00Z (6-hour window) with rate limit to avoid re-triggering consolidation.
- Verification: post-purge integrity checks against manifest hashes and a sampleredaction review (we will provide checksums and a redacted index).
- Subprocessor disclosures: SnapshotCo (eu-west-1), FastMover (global/edge), and our long-term storage partner ColdHold (eu-central-1). We can provide signed subprocess agreements and last 90-day access logs for SnapshotCo under NDA.
- Controls: manual gating by on-call engineer + one Legal witness before final deletion; we will snapshot all artifacts to an escrow bucket for 30 days (immutable) pending audit, then delete following your confirmation.

We propose the 72-hour conditional bridge Marissa suggested but with the tighter 6-hour operational purge to reduce exposure. If HealthBridge Legal agrees, we'll start preparatory steps tonight.

Attachments: purge-timeline-v1.xlsx (operational steps, checks, rollback)

Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, Karen Su <karen.su@healthbridge.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor access log summary + retention exception details

Quick update from infra:

- Access logs: SnapshotCo read-only transfer initiated 2027-04-27T22:10Z; transfer completed 2027-04-28T00:15Z. FastMover sessions were ephemeral (SSH tunnel) and originated from ephemeral IPs owned by FastMover. No third-party wrote to the objects during the consolidation window.
- Retention exception: we will treat this as a Controlled Retention Exception (CRE) and issue an official record in our DPA incident log. CRE will include: timestamps, operator IDs, reason code "CONSOLIDATION_OVERLAP", and mitigations performed.
- Evidence artifacts we will deliver: SHA256 manifest list, worker traces (redacted), SnapshotCo transfer logs (redacted), and a signed attestation from SnapshotCo that no customer content was extracted. All items will be uploaded to the Drive link and a secure pre-signed S3 share.

Next step: Marissa / Kimberly — please confirm the operational start time. Karen — if HealthBridge Legal needs a written DPA addendum for the CRE, we can draft one and route it for signature within 24 hours.

Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Karen Su <karen.su@healthbridge.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@healthbridge.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Backup purge lag + SLA bridging plan

Team —

Thanks for the detailed plan and the transparency. HealthBridge Legal has reviewed the proposed CRE workflow and is amenable to a conditional 72-hour bridging window provided we receive:

1) The purge-timeline-v1.xlsx with the operational checkboxes completed and a named Legal approver.
2) The redacted SnapshotCo transfer log and the SHA256 manifest list uploaded to the shared Drive link.
3) A short DPA addendum draft that acknowledges the CRE, the preservation escrow for 30 days, and the signatures required to finalize the deletion.

If you can deliver 1–3 by EOD Wednesday (2027-05-05), we will not escalate to procurement and will consider this closed pending the evidence upload.

Karen Su
Head of Platform Ops
HealthBridge

Attachments received: healthbridge_evidence.zip (we will place the SnapshotCo logs into the Drive after redaction)
